chains.filter_inet.forward.description: The rules of the inet filter table's forward chain, one statement per line (nft syntax, e.g. `type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;` then `ct state established,related accept`). Unset: the shipped default chain.

chains.filter_inet.input.description: The rules of the inet filter table's input chain, one statement per line (nft syntax, e.g. `type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;` then `ct state established,related accept`). Unset: the shipped default chain.

chains.filter_inet.output.description: The rules of the inet filter table's output chain, one statement per line (nft syntax, e.g. `type filter hook output priority filter; policy drop;` then `ct state established,related accept`). Unset: the shipped default chain.

defines.description: List of global defines (e.g., IP ranges, port sets) for reuse across rules.
